title: Pricing agreement: Garnet Tooling
content:
Supply agreement between Harborline Industrial Supply and Garnet Tooling, effective 2026-04-01 to 2027-03-31.
BIT-CRB-6, carbide bit 6mm, pack: $37.60 per pack.
BIT-CRB-8, carbide bit 8mm, pack: $44.20 per pack.
Prices exclude freight. Items not listed are billed at list price.
